name: struct
description: All the code, in one place

scripts.setup: npm install  ./ && npm install ./frontend-internal && npm install  ./backend-node  && npm install ./frontend-public && npm install ./frontend-design-website
scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run internal" "npm run public" "npm run design"
scripts.backend-publish: cd backend-node && pm2 stop index.js && pm2 restart index.js
scripts.internal-publish: cd frontend-internal && sudo rm -rf /var/www/internal.struct.services/* && sudo cp ./build/* /var/www/internal.struct.services
